About Akash Kumar Prasad: Full-stack developer building AI-powered web apps and the backends behind them.
Akash is pursuing a B.S. in Data Science and Applications at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras.
He builds full-stack products with Next.js, TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, including AI features that stay tied to real project data.
The projects on this site are public on GitHub, including BuilderBridge, SynergySphere, Claso, Ramso, IntelCraft, a Telegram reminder bot, and YT-Slice.
At the Odoo x Paradox hackathon at IIT Madras he built SynergySphere, a team workspace with tasks, chat, mentions, and dashboards.
Based in India. Website: https://akashkumarprasad.com. Resume: /Akash_resume.pdf. Email: akash.iit.work@gmail.com.
Areas of focus: AI-assisted web products with Next.js, the Vercel AI SDK, and human approval before writes; Python services for video generation, code comments, and Telegram agents; PostgreSQL, Prisma, Drizzle, and auth with Better Auth; Interfaces in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.

Technical skills of Akash:
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, SQL.
Frontend: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, HTML, CSS.
Backend and APIs: Node.js, FastAPI, WebSockets, REST.
Databases and storage: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, SQLite, Supabase, Firebase, Prisma, Drizzle.
AI and ML: Vercel AI SDK, OpenAI, Groq, Gemini, LangGraph, PyTorch, Transformers.
DevOps and cloud: Docker, Git, GitHub, Vercel, Render, Railway.
Tools and practices: DBMS, Data Science, Postman, REST APIs.

Open source: Akash is a public projects of GitHub since Ongoing.
Full-stack products, a hackathon workspace, and smaller tools, with source linked from the projects page. The contribution graph on the home page is counted live.
Repository: https://github.com/Akash8585

Achievements of Akash:
Odoo x Paradox Hackathon, IIT Madras. Built SynergySphere, a team workspace with tasks, threaded chat, mentions, notifications, and project dashboards.

Question: Where is Akash studying?
Answer: Akash is pursuing a B.S. in Data Science and Applications at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras.

Question: What kind of work does Akash enjoy most?
Answer: He builds full-stack products where an interface and a backend have to agree: AI features that cite live data, Python tools for video and code, and small agents that turn a message into a scheduled task.

content:
Project: BuilderBridge. AI-assisted construction control room that connects schedules, critical-path planning, weekly commitments, field progress, RFIs, and project documents. Its project-aware agent cites live data, prepares reviewable changes, and applies them only after permission checks and human approval.
Tech: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vercel AI SDK, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Better Auth, Supabase.
Links: Website: https://builderbridge.vercel.app/, Source: https://github.com/Akash8585/builderbridge, Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MyIDR62UqKg.

Project: SynergySphere. Team workspace built at the Odoo x Paradox hackathon at IIT Madras: task management, threaded chat, mentions, notifications, and project dashboards.
Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, better-auth, PostgreSQL, Drizzle.
Links: Source: https://github.com/Akash8585/SynergySphere, Demo: https://youtu.be/baCzpVf0wYM.

Project: Claso. Full-stack code assistant that uses custom-trained transformer models to write code comments and context-aware commit messages for Python and JavaScript, without calling an external model API.
Tech: React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Monaco Editor, Python, FastAPI, PyTorch, Transformers.
Links: Source: https://github.com/Akash8585/claso, Demo: https://youtu.be/h9gdoTIhw48.

Project: Ramso. One-click AI video generator that turns a concept into an educational explainer: a script, Manim animation, a voiceover, and a downloadable MP4.
Tech: Python, Streamlit, Agno, OpenAI, Manim, Neets AI, FFmpeg.
Links: Source: https://github.com/Akash8585/Ramso.

Project: IntelCraft. Outreach assistant for students and freshers. It looks up a company, drafts a personalized email or cover letter, and streams progress over WebSockets.
Tech: React, TypeScript, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, WebSockets, LangGraph, Vercel, Railway.
Links: Website: https://intel-craft.vercel.app/, Source: https://github.com/Akash8585/IntelCraft.

Project: Todo Telegram Agent. Telegram reminder bot that turns a sentence into a scheduled task. Groq parses the intent and time, SQLite stores the task, and a scheduler sends the reminder with Done and Snooze actions.
Tech: Python, FastAPI, SQLModel, SQLite, python-telegram-bot, APScheduler, Groq.
Links: Source: https://github.com/Akash8585/todo_telegram_agent.

Project: YT-Slice. Calculates the total and average length of a YouTube playlist range, and how long that range takes at different playback speeds.
Tech: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, React Hook Form, YouTube Data API.
Links: Website: https://yt-slice.vercel.app/, Source: https://github.com/Akash8585/YT-slice.

Contact and social links for Akash: LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/in/akash-kumar-prasad-82b1a1285/), GitHub (https://github.com/Akash8585), X (https://x.com/akash87478), Email (mailto:akash.iit.work@gmail.com). Contact form: /contact. Resume: /Akash_resume.pdf.
